NTEMS data

Source: R/NTEMS.R
ntems.Rd

Get and prepare data from NTEMS (https://opendata.nfis.org/mapserver/nfis-change_eng.html).

Usage

ntems(type, dest_dir = NULL, study_area = NULL)

Arguments

type

character, specifying which NTEMS product to download and prepare (see Details).

dest_dir

character, specifying the destination directory in which to download and extract the data (defaults to current working directory).

study_area

(optional) sf polygon to which the national raster will be cropped and masked.

Value

SpatRaster

Details

type must be one of the following:

  • age: forest age (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2023.113529 );

  • d2sc: distance-to-second-class for tree species (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 );

  • fao: forest area based on FAO definitions for Canada (doi:10.1093/forestry/cpaa006 );

  • fires, harvest: wildfire or harvest disturbances (doi:10.1080/17538947.2016.1187673 );

  • firesrecovery, harvestrecovery: post-disturbance forest recovery data (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2017.03.035 , doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.112904 );

  • firesy2r, harvesty2r: post-disturbance years-to-recovery (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2017.03.035 , doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.112904 );

  • landcover<year>: annual forest landcover 1984-2019 (doi:10.1080/07038992.2018.1437719 , doi:10.1016/j.rse.2021.112780 )

  • leadingspecies: leading tree species (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 );

  • sbfi: Satellite-Based Forest Inventory (doi:10.1093/forestry/cpad065 );

  • speciesprobs: tree species probabilities (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2022.113276 );

  • wildfirednbr: wildfire differenced Normalized Burn Ratio (doi:10.1016/j.rse.2014.11.005 ; doi:10.1016/j.rse.2015.09.004 );

Note

Currently only supports the most recent data (made available 2019 or later). Previous NTEMS products (e.g., 2015 forest data) can be downloaded from the NTEMS site linked above.
